newsitem.title: USA: Champion, Redman shareholders approve merger.
newsitem.headline: Champion, Redman shareholders approve merger.

text.p: Champion Enterprises Inc and Redman Industries Inc said Thursday that shareholders at both companies approved Champion's purchase of the Dallas-based mobile home maker.

Terms of the deal, announced August 20, call for Champion, which operates manufactured housing facilities, to issue 1.24 shares of its common stock for each outstanding share of Redman common stock. Public trading of Redman stock will cease at the end of business Thursday.
Following the merger, proforma 1995 results for the combined companies would be revenues of $1.4 billion with net income of $56.3 million, or $1.14 a share.

More than 99 percent of Redman shareholders approved the deal, and more than 99 percent of Champion holders voted to approve the issuance of 17.3 million shares needed for the purchase, the firms said.
Champion said the new company will have virtually no debt by the end of 1996, and should be able to grow at a more than 20 percent compound annual growth rate.
